Questions, answered

Frequently asked questions

All FAQsContact us
Do you place new graduate therapists?

Yes, on assignments where the facility offers supervision or mentorship. Tell your recruiter you are a new graduate or clinical fellow and we will show you the roles that fit.

Which settings can I work in?

Outpatient clinics, inpatient rehab units, skilled nursing facilities, home health agencies and schools. You choose the settings you want to see.

How long are therapy contracts?

Most travel and local contracts run about thirteen weeks, and school-based roles usually follow the academic calendar. Extensions are common when both sides are happy.
